title: Presbyterian women's tennis edged by Wofford in close road match - Upper West SC News
text:
The Presbyterian College women’s tennis team narrowly lost to Wofford, 4-3, in a closely contested match at the Reeves Tennis Center in Spartanburg on Saturday. The Blue Hose started strong by winning the doubles point after victories on courts two and three. Grace Katzman and Mary Ellen Longmire secured a 6-4 win on court two, while Ladina Bruhin and Roxy Valdes clinched a 7-6 (2) win on court three.
Wofford responded in singles play with wins on courts two and three. Longmire evened the score for Presbyterian with a straight-set victory on court six. The Terriers regained the lead with a win on the top singles court, but Sofia Rodrigo Hidalgo tied the match again for Presbyterian by winning her match on court five in three sets.
The outcome was decided on court four. Ella Suk of Wofford took the first set before Luciana Parrilli of Presbyterian forced a third set by taking the second set 7-5. Suk then closed out the match for Wofford with a 6-4, 5-7, 6-4 victory.
Following this result, Presbyterian’s record moves to 4-8 for the season. The team will have a break before their next match against Gardner-Webb scheduled for March 19.
